<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_RoboticBurgerSeller" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/robotic-burger-seller">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_RoboticBurgerSeller" name="Robotic Burger Seller near the University of Vienna" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderPlaced" name="Order placed">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToReceive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOrder" name="Receive order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToReceive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveToMenuDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MenuDecision" name="Menu or burger only?" default="Flow_BurgerOnly">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceiveToMenuDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MenuChosen</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BurgerOnly</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_MenuSplit" name="Menu split">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MenuChosen</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToPrepareDrink</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToAskFriesWedges</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareDrink" name="Prepare drink">
      <bpmn:documentation>The duration depends on the size of the drink and can vary.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToPrepareDrink</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DrinkToMenuJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AskFriesOrWedges" name="Ask fries or wedges">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToAskFriesWedges</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AskToMenuJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_MenuJoin" name="Menu join">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DrinkToMenuJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AskToMenuJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_JoinToSideDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SideDecision" name="Fries or wedges?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_JoinToSideDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ChooseFries</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ChooseWedges</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFries" name="Prepare fries">
      <bpmn:documentation>The duration depends on the size of the fries order and can vary.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ChooseFries</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FriesToBurgerMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareWedges" name="Prepare wedges">
      <bpmn:documentation>The duration depends on the size of the wedges order and can vary.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ChooseWedges</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WedgesToBurgerMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BurgerMerge" name="Side ready or burger only">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FriesToBurgerMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WedgesToBurgerMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BurgerOnly</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeToPrepareBurger</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareBurger" name="Prepare burger">
      <bpmn:documentation>The duration depends on the number of ingredients and can vary.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeToPrepareBurger</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PrepareBurgerToDeliver</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Timer_StatusUpdate" name="Every 30 seconds" attachedToRef="Task_PrepareBurger" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TimerToStatusUpdate</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDef_StatusUpdate">
        <bpmn:timeCycle xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">R/PT30S</bpmn:timeCycle>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StatusUpdate" name="Give enthusiastic status update">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TimerToStatusUpdate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StatusUpdateToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_StatusUpdate" name="Status update given">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StatusUpdateToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverOrder" name="Deliver order via conveyor belt">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PrepareBurgerToDeliver</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DeliverToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderDelivered" name="Order delivered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DeliverToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToReceive" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderPlaced" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveToMenuDecision" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOrder" targetRef="Gateway_MenuDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuChosen" name="Menu" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuDecision" targetRef="Gateway_MenuSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${wantsMenu}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BurgerOnly" name="Burger only" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuDecision" targetRef="Gateway_BurgerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToPrepareDrink" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareDrink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToAskFriesWedges" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuSplit" targetRef="Task_AskFriesOrWedges"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DrinkToMenuJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDrink" targetRef="Gateway_MenuJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AskToMenuJoin" sourceRef="Task_AskFriesOrWedges" targetRef="Gateway_MenuJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToSideDecision" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuJoin" targetRef="Gateway_SideDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChooseFries" name="Fries" sourceRef="Gateway_SideDecision" targetRef="Task_PrepareFries">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${wantsFries}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChooseWedges" name="Wedges" sourceRef="Gateway_SideDecision" targetRef="Task_PrepareWedges">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${wantsWedges}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriesToBurgerMerge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFries" targetRef="Gateway_BurgerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WedgesToBurgerMerge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareWedges" targetRef="Gateway_BurgerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToPrepareBurger" sourceRef="Gateway_BurgerMerge" targetRef="Task_PrepareBurger"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareBurgerToDeliver" sourceRef="Task_PrepareBurger" targetRef="Task_DeliverOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TimerToStatusUpdate" sourceRef="Timer_StatusUpdate" targetRef="Task_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusUpdateToEnd" sourceRef="Task_StatusUpdate" targetRef="EndEvent_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeliverToEnd" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderDelivered"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
